component.name: PDFchemy Tools
component.summary: Local-First Emergency Document Utility Built For The People

description.p: PDFchemy Tools is a 100% offline, privacy-first emergency document utility built for the people. All PDF operations execute locally on your machine with zero cloud uploads and zero telemetry.

ul.li: Visual Page Studio: Rearrange, rotate, delete, and duplicate pages with responsive visual thumbnail cards.
Smart Target Compressor: Optimize DPI and JPEG quality to guarantee your document fits under email or portal size budgets (e.g. under 2MB).
Images ⇄ PDF Studio: Compile collections of photos or receipts into a PDF, or batch-extract all pages as high-res PNG images.
Multi-Core Batch Queue: Process 50+ PDFs simultaneously across all CPU cores.
Reflow Reader: Distraction-free reading with typography scaling and dark/sepia themes.
Document Security: 128/256-bit AES password encryption and safe password removal.

description.p: Default Language & Stability: Permanent default startup language setting with file-backed persistence in ~/.pdfchemy/config.properties, robust Escape key navigation preventing accidental closure of the document reader, and enhanced download domain support for the in-app updater.

Ultimate PDF Viewing Experience: Borderless full screen immersion, PDF bookmarks outline tree, smooth zoom and 2.5x magnifier loupe, nightlight candlelight and paper dimmer, dyslexia suite with reading ruler guide, real-time color blindness matrices, and 100% offline speech synthesis.
Security enhancements with universal Vanguard Zero-Trust shield integration, EPUB text extraction support, and comprehensive performance optimizations.
Full multi-language dynamic localization across 20 languages with automatic OS detection, first-run setup modal, and CLI configuration flags.
Hardened Gauntlet release featuring true forensic redaction, corrupted PDF recovery and reconstruction, and target-size anti-inflation safeguards.
Official release featuring Visual Page Studio, Smart Target-Size Compressor, Images ⇄ PDF Studio, Multi-Core Batch Queue, and the Lifetime Manifesto.
